title: Cancellation and Refund Terms Table — Northloop Protect Plans
content:
Every one of the Northloop Protect Plans shares the same cancellation terms: a free cancellation period of 30 calendar days after plan purchase, within which a cancellation with no claim paid is refunded in full; a prorated refund for a later cancellation, computed on the unused coverage days over the term days; an administrative fee of 10 per cent (0.1) of the plan price, capped at 25.00 USD; claim settlements paid deducted from the refund; and refunds sent to the original payment method.

## Terms by plan

| Plan | Free cancellation period | Later cancellation earns a prorated refund | Proration basis | Administrative fee rate | Administrative fee cap (USD) | Claim settlements paid deducted from the refund | Refunds sent to |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Protect 1-Year Extended Warranty | 30 calendar days after plan purchase | Yes | Unused days over term days | 10 per cent of the plan price | 25.00 | Yes | Original payment method |
| Protect 2-Year Extended Warranty | 30 calendar days after plan purchase | Yes | Unused days over term days | 10 per cent of the plan price | 25.00 | Yes | Original payment method |
| Protect 3-Year Extended Warranty | 30 calendar days after plan purchase | Yes | Unused days over term days | 10 per cent of the plan price | 25.00 | Yes | Original payment method |
| Protect 2-Year Accident Protection | 30 calendar days after plan purchase | Yes | Unused days over term days | 10 per cent of the plan price | 25.00 | Yes | Original payment method |
| Protect 3-Year Accident Protection | 30 calendar days after plan purchase | Yes | Unused days over term days | 10 per cent of the plan price | 25.00 | Yes | Original payment method |
| Protect 4-Year Accident Protection | 30 calendar days after plan purchase | Yes | Unused days over term days | 10 per cent of the plan price | 25.00 | Yes | Original payment method |

## Notes to the table

- **Anchor of the free period.** The 30 calendar days are counted after the date the plan was bought, not after the covered item's order or delivery.
- **Administrative fee.** The fee is the lower of 10 per cent of the plan price and 25.00 USD. Because 10 per cent of a plan price above 250.00 USD would exceed 25.00 USD, the cap is the fee for any plan price above that figure.

## Hypothetical figures

| Hypothetical plan price (USD) | 10 per cent of the plan price (USD) | Administrative fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| 199.99 | 19.999 | 19.999, below the cap |
| 329.99 | 32.999 | 25.00, the cap |
